title: Managing Growing Wild Boar Population in Bukit Panjang
what_it_is: Managing Growing Wild Boar Population in Bukit Panjang

sections.label: Wild boar removal Bukit Panjang
sections.summary: NParks has trapped and removed 19 wild boars near Bukit Panjang since May and is installing exclusion fences.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: For instance, NParks has trapped and removed 19 wild boars from the vicinity of Bukit Panjang since May this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: In addition, NParks has been installing exclusion fences to reduce the possibility of wild boars entering the estate.

sections.label: Wild boar population in nature reserves
sections.summary: NParks studies show these measures kept the wild boar population in nature reserves stable and at lower density than similar regional reserves.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Based on studies by NParks, these measures have helped to keep the wild boar population in our nature reserves stable, at a density that is lower than those recorded in similar forest reserves in the region.

sections.label: Removing wild boars from residential areas
sections.summary: NParks will trap and remove any wild boar found in a residential area to ensure public safety.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: NParks will trap and remove any wild boar that is found in a residential area, to ensure public safety.

sections.label: Fencing and cattle grids at access points
sections.summary: NParks is installing exclusion fencing and cattle grids at three access points, with Bangkit underpass grids completed 23 June 2023 and Chestnut Avenue and Gali Batu works expected by end-August 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: In Pulau Ubin, it has been observed that wild boars tend to avoid stepping across such cattle grids.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Therefore, to restrict the wild boars access to Zhenghua Nature Park, NParks has been installing a combination of exclusion fencing and cattle grids at three access points where we have deemed it more likely that wild boars could enter the residential areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The cattle grids at the Bangkit underpass were completed on 23 June 2023 and our monitoring shows that these grids, as well as the areas with exclusion fencing, have been effective so far.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: NParks is also installing a combination of exclusion fences and cattle grids along Chestnut Avenue and under the Gali Batu flyover.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: These works are expected to be completed by end-August 2023.

sections.label: Camera trap study of wild boar density
sections.summary: A 2019-2020 NParks camera trap study found wild boar density of about 6.57 per square kilometre in nature reserves and 5.22 in nature parks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Between 2019 and 2020, NParks conducted a study using camera traps which found that the density of wild boars was about 6.57 per kilometre square in our nature reserves and about 5.22 per kilometre square in our nature parks.

sections.label: Effectiveness of removing few wild boars
sections.summary: A question asks how effective removing and killing a small number of wild boars is, given their high reproduction rate, referencing the camera trap study.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Again, considering the high reproduction rate of these wild boars, how effective is it to just remove a small number of wild boars and kill them?

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: I explained earlier about our study which used camera traps in our nature parks and nature reserves.

sections.label: Science-based wild boar management approach
sections.summary: The approach uses evidence, partners with institutes and industry, and includes exclusion fences, cattle grids, public education and tracking of wild boar density.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: When I say "science-based", it is that we want to look at evidence and we work very closely with our institutes of higher learning, researchers, international partners and industry partners, to make sure that our approach is in line with best practices around the world.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: But it is also not just about removing wild boars.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: I explained our approach earlier in terms of how we have exclusion fences, cattle grids, and how we work together with the community to educate members of the public and our residents about feeding wildlife, and how we use a science-based approach to track the carrying capacity or density of wild boars.
